It supports the complete process of registering vital events, such as births and deaths, while ensuring offline functionality for remote areas, robust data security, and adherence to global CRVS standards. Tailored for low- and middle-income countries, OpenCRVS is user-centric, inclusive, and enables governments to provide legal identity for all, improve access to essential services, and generate vital statistics for policy-making.

name: UPYOG
description: The Urban Platform for DeliverY of Online Governance (UPYOG) is a set of Open APIs, services, and reference implementations, setup as a public good, to allow government entities, businesses, startups, and civil society to use a unique digital Infrastructure and build solutions at a large scale.
